name: Byte Metaverse Holdings Limited
summary: Byte Metaverse Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides managed internet services in Malaysia. The company offers network support services, including network infrastructure design and hardware installation, and network management and security services. It also provides network connectivity services, such as intranet and internet connectivity solutions and value-added services. Byte Metaverse Holdings Limited was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
